optimized_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM store_sales
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM time_dim
    WHERE time_dim.t_time_sk = store_sales.ss_sold_time_sk
      AND time_dim.t_hour = 8
      AND time_dim.t_minute >= 30
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM household_demographics
    WHERE household_demographics.hd_demo_sk = store_sales.ss_hdemo_sk
      AND household_demographics.hd_dep_count = 0
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM store
    WHERE store.s_store_sk = store_sales.ss_store_sk
      AND store.s_store_name = 'ese'
)
ORDER BY COUNT(*)
LIMIT 100
